description: Shiso's docs.json support contract. This describes the configuration surface Shiso intentionally supports; it is not a promise to reproduce another documentation product.

categories.native: Implemented as a Shiso feature and strictly validated.
categories.unsupported: Outside the current contract and rejected with a validation error.

principles: The theme field selects Shiso themes only.
Hosted services and provider-specific integrations are not part of the core configuration contract.
Static-site behavior is implemented where it is meaningful across deployment targets.
Shiso-specific options live under the $shiso namespace.

$ref.detail: Relative JSON references are resolved before schema validation. Object siblings override referenced fields; arrays and primitive values replace the reference object.

theme.detail: Only themes registered by Shiso are valid.

favicon.detail: String paths are supported; per-mode objects are not implemented yet.

thumbnails.detail: Generated social thumbnails are not a core feature.

icons.detail: Icon rendering is currently provided by Shiso's Lucide registry.

navbar.detail: Shiso uses generic links and does not provide hosted counters for provider-specific link types.

contextual.detail: Static page actions and external links are supported; hosted actions are not.

variables.detail: Build-time content variables are not implemented yet.

api.detail: API specification rendering is not implemented.

markdown.detail: Shiso always emits page Markdown; additional Markdown settings are not implemented yet.

integrations.detail: Provider integrations belong in application code rather than docs.json.

exceptions.detail: Shiso does not implement or alias third-party themes.
Only a single favicon path is currently accepted.
Use a generic link with label and/or icon.
Shiso currently uses an array of generic links.
Only the default or first language is rendered.
Only the default or first version is rendered.
